Your business is in a healthy surplus position for this period.

Your income of 58,860 comfortably exceeds spending of 48,147, giving you a net cash flow of 10,713. That's a strong cushion. However, two things deserve attention. First, your top three clients represent 48.6 percent of income—meaning if one major client pauses work, your cash position becomes fragile. Second, utilities alone consume 51.1 percent of total spending at 24,609, suggesting either high operational overhead or a cost structure that deserves review.

Keep your income diversified by pursuing additional clients beyond your current ten sources. Review your utilities category to identify whether those costs are truly necessary or if you can negotiate better rates. Your discretionary spending of 23,538 is well-balanced against fixed costs, so your spending mix is reasonable. Continue monitoring that top-client concentration closely.
